title: Early Modern Weather Database: dated weather events in England and Wales from diaries, chronicles and agricultural records (ArcGIS layer)
licence: none stated on the ArcGIS layer — private pack
describe: Rain, cold, storms, floods, droughts, earthquakes and other weather recorded by contemporaries (Josselin, Pepys, Evelyn, Holinshed, Stow and others), each at the place and in the year(s) the record gives; records the database marks as imprecisely located are drawn as approximate.
